scope: Actual local workerd/D1 SQLite/R2 and captured Resend request; no cloud resource, production database or mailbox delivery. Browser form checks recorded separately.

cases.name: contact upload is stored byte-for-byte and sent as an actual attachment
sample and batch inquiries preserve required details and unknown quantity
email rejection preserves the record/file and administrative recovery reads the saved file
database failure returns an error and retry reuses the saved file without losing its bytes
concurrent duplicate requests create one row and one notification
invalid origin and invalid payloads never add a record or send mail
the full advertised 5 MiB PDF boundary is stored and attached intact
oversized streaming JSON and malformed JSON are rejected before persistence
missing private storage fails closed for a file inquiry
